title: Why Cheap AI Tokens Can Cost You More
speaker: Andy Nikulin
summary: Andy Nikulin walks through the grey market for discounted AI tokens, from subscription arbitrage to token "transfer stations", and what the discount costs you.
takeaways: SemiAnalysis got over $11,000 of API-priced tokens from a $200 Anthropic subscription
Brokers resell corporate discounts, farmed credits, idle subscriptions and stolen accounts
One station sold Gemini 4 Carbon at 55% off within days of launch
The catch: swapped models, pricier cached tokens, harvested prompts, deposits that vanish
He only uses them for apps that are "not super important and not super secret"
